text:
Symptom: GL detail export for a full month times out after 120 s (February close).
Question: Is it the number of rows or the server load on the first working day?

Attempt: Re-run the full-month export.
Result: Same timeout after 120 s.

Attempt: Export 1-14 and 15-end of month separately and merge.
Result: Two files download. The merge is manual; a single full-month export is still not working.

Symptom: The March export needed the same workaround.
Question: Can the manual merge paste the boundary day (14th) twice and create duplicate entries?
Action (Mark): Follow up the ERP vendor ticket on the export timeout.
Action (Unassigned): Add a duplicate entry_id check to the close procedure.
